fit_scope: training fixture observation IDs only; held-out fixture excluded
limitations: The ordered state coordinates are an architectural scaffold rather than learned semantic identities.
The multi-start analysis is a finite robustness result, not population-level inference.
underpowered_cases: The current authored-fixture surface is below the protocol minimum independent-family target; fixture identities are not independent source lineages.
unsupported_cases: Held-out label fitting and post-hoc state relabeling are unsupported by the fitting contract.
